reviews.title: Major bug that needs fixed
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for about a week now and I wanted some more insight, so I payed for the subscription. And now on the MAP I CANT EVEN SEE THE STUFF IM TRYING TO SEE. Because there is a BIG SHARE button right across the bottom of the map. Like for one it’s cool to have the option so share the workout but why does it need to be the main focus from and center on my screen? Make it like a small button that doesn’t overlay over everything. I literally cannot even see the meter at the bottom of the map showing my pace and stuff because of this share button. It’s so beyond frustrating considering I just payed money to not even be able to see exactly what I payed money to see. I tired going into the settings to turn off sharing or some thing but I cannot. I really hope they can fix this. Sharing my workout is not my main focus or reasoning for getting this app. Please just let me see my insights.

reviews.title: Love it, it’s so helpful
reviews.text:
Thank you for this app, it’s wonderful - it’s helping me train for my first triathlon 🎉
One recommendation. A graph of some sort in the activity stats visually showing your pace over the entire activity - just some sort of speed relative to distance visual aid. Kinda like AllTrails feature that shows elevation gain throughout your hike. This would be tremendously helpful for tracking pacing throughout the run and seeing your pattern of where you slow down, rather than only seeing the max min and average pace. Thank you so much, I love the app :)
